hero.title: About NexChem
hero.subtitle: A chemical partner built on reliability, reach, and technical care.

intro.headline: Nearly three decades connecting manufacturers to markets
paragraphs: NexChem Chemicals is a distributor and supplier of chemical products across a multitude of industries, with a history spanning the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia.
Our mission is to deliver value by moving chemicals efficiently from manufacturers to end users — with a primary focus on paints & coatings, construction, food, and personal care.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: The group originated in Amritsar in 1940, building a reputation in dyes and pigments before expanding internationally. In 1989, headquarters were established in the United Arab Emirates to serve a growing regional network.
Today, decades of industry exposure and an expanding portfolio allow us to offer basic and specialty chemicals through collaboration with leading manufacturers worldwide.
